title: OPTIMITIVE and Grey Build partner on AI optimisation in cement industry
summary: OPTIMITIVE and Grey Build partner on AI optimisation in cement industry
body_markdown:
**Spain:** OPTIMITIVE has entered a collaboration agreement with Grey Build, an operating unit of thyssenkrupp Polysius, to bring its artificial intelligence (AI)-powered optimisation platform to cement producers in North America. Under the agreement, Grey Build will make OPTIMITIVE’s OPTIBAT platform available to its customers, offering autonomous, real-time process optimisation to improve energy efficiency, increase production throughput and reduce emissions.


The partnership combines OPTIMITIVE’s AI-powered optimisation technology with Grey Build’s process expertise. The companies aim to deliver scalable, data-driven solutions to support industrial decarbonisation. OPTIMITIVE CEO Fernando de la Prida said “This agreement reinforces our strategy of building alliances with integrators and manufacturers in the sector.” Olivier Terver, Global Head of Grey Build, said “Working with OPTIMITIVE enables our customers to ramp up the performance of their investment faster and reach sustained results quicker.”


OPTIMITIVE, founded in 2008 and headquartered in Vitoria-Gasteiz, Spain, operates in seven major global regions and has deployed its technology at more than 75 industrial facilities across sectors including cement, chemicals, mining, paper and metals.
